decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express delivery program builds directly on the firm's existing manufacturing, planning, and service capabilities, and its continued website presence through 2024 suggests the firm has learned how to run it as a viable extension of the core business.

The seventy-two-hour express delivery program is closely related to the firm's installed operational knowledge but is more demanding and costly to execute than slower express offers, so it is somewhat more at risk even though it remained on the website in 2024.

This express delivery line for doors and gates has high relatedness to the firm's core product and logistics knowledge and its dedicated page in both years indicates strong commitment and ongoing refinement rather than likely withdrawal.

The online ordering and digital services platform is slightly less rooted in traditional metal-product know-how but strongly complements the firm's advisory and service model, and its continued standalone presentation implies the firm sees enough learning and strategic value to continue.

The fire and smoke protection door fits the firm's deepest technical, regulatory, and safety-compliance competences, and its move from a mention in 2023 to a page of its own in 2024 signals successful absorption of market feedback and likely further commercialization.
